title: Canada Goose Festive Global Windows, 2025

cover.alt: Festive global windows campaign for Canada Goose, featuring immersive storefront displays designed by Ibby Njoya and photographed by Campbell Addy. Installed across New York, Hong Kong, London, Shanghai, and Toronto for the 2025 holiday season. The window display features two mannequins dressed in all-white Canada Goose outerwear — puffer jackets, scarves, and beanies — set against a dramatic blue-lit arctic landscape with sculptural blue foam formations evoking glaciers or ice cliffs, and a starry night sky backdrop.
